description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveRequestDaoTest' for testing the 'LeaveRequestDao' data access object related to leave requests within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class includes setup procedures, multiple test methods for CRUD operations, overlapping leave retrieval, entitlement management, leave status changes, and subunit employee retrieval, all designed to verify the database interactions and business logic of leave management.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing various functionalities of the LeaveRequestDao in the OrangeHRM system, including CRUD operations, overlapping leave detection, entitlement management, leave status changes, subunit employee retrieval, and transaction handling.
